ac_present.title: Acceptance criteria
ac_present.missing: We could not find acceptance criteria.
ac_present.add:
You can copy this and adjust it to your case. Either format works. A short list under an "Acceptance criteria" heading, one result per line:

## Acceptance criteria
- The message "Nessun movimento trovato" is shown

Or Given / When / Then, each at the start of its line:

Given the movement list has no rows for this filter
When I filter by document 22
Then the message is "Nessun movimento trovato"

Italian works too: "Criteri di accettazione", or Dato / Quando / Allora.
ac_present.question: What should the user see when this is done? Plain sentences (at least 150 characters), or Given / When / Then.
ac_present.example: The Delete button is disabled for a warehouse that still has stock. Hovering it shows the tooltip "Empty the warehouse first" and no delete request is sent.
ac_present.label: acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then, or a list under an Acceptance criteria heading) — in the field or description

ac_testable.title: Acceptance criteria: results must be specific
ac_testable.missing: An acceptance criterion does not state a concrete result.
ac_testable.add:
Please avoid "it works" or "as expected". A number or the exact text on screen is enough, for example:

- The grid shows exactly 5 rows
Then the message is "Nessun movimento trovato"
ac_testable.question: An acceptance criterion is vague. Write it again with something a test can see (a label, a row count, a toast), at least 150 characters, or as Given / When / Then.
ac_testable.example: The grid shows exactly 5 rows after filtering by code 22, one per matching product, and the counter above the grid reads 5 results. Rows for code 220 are not shown.
ac_testable.label: testable AC — each Then or AC item an observable assertion, not "works correctly"

steps.title: Steps to reproduce
steps.missing: There is no Steps to reproduce section (or user story).
steps.add:
A short numbered list is enough. You can adapt this:

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the movement list
2. Filter by document 22
3. Look at the rows that come back
steps.question: How do you reproduce it? One step per line.
steps.example:
Open the products stock
Filter by a code that does not exist
Look at the empty grid
steps.label: steps to reproduce (Bug) or a user story (Story)

expected_defined.title: Expected and actual result
expected_defined.missing: Expected and Actual are not both filled in.
expected_defined.add:
Please add both sections, for example:

## Expected
Only document 22 is listed

## Actual
Document 220 is listed as well
expected_defined.question: What should you see, and what do you see now? Write: expected | actual
expected_defined.example: The message "Nessun dato" is shown | The grid is blank
expected_defined.label: clear expected behavior (or Expected vs Actual for a bug)
